3. Clicking squares sometimes moves them along their trails

The purple square moved from (41,49) → (44,51) → (46,52).
The current positions are orange at (13,49) and purple at (46,52). These seem to be the final positions based on the trail.
Maybe the goal is not to move the squares further but to convert all gray diamonds to white. But the toggle behavior makes this impossible - I can only have one white diamond at a time in each group.
Wait, let me reconsider. Maybe the goal is to have the squares at their final positions AND have specific diamonds white. The final state might be:
- Orange square at (13,49)
- Purple square at (46,52)
- Some diamonds white, some gray
But which diamonds should be white?
Looking at the image, the purple square is at (46,52) and there's a white diamond at (48,54) below it. The orange square is at (13,49) and there's a gray ring at (18,55) below it.
Maybe the goal is to have the white diamond adjacent to each square. Currently (48,54) is white and adjacent to the purple square at (46,52). I need to make (18,55) white and adjacent to the orange square at (13,49).
Let me try clicking (18,55) to convert it to white.
